hotel.name: Aegean Bliss Resort, Disney World, Orlando, Florida

day_by_day.morning: No activities — flight arrives at 10:30 PM
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities — in transit
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Orlando International Airport at 10:30 PM. Take Disney's free Magical Express shuttle or a budget rideshare (Lyft/Uber ~$25–35) to Aegean Bliss Resort. Check in, unpack, and review your park tickets and plans for the week. Pick up any essentials at the resort gift shop or vending machines.

meals.breakfast: Eat before or during your flight
meals.lunch: Grab a meal at the airport before departure or during a layover
meals.dinner: Late-night snack from resort vending machines or a quick-service stop near the hotel lobby — budget ~$8–12

day_by_day.notes: Download the My Disney Experience app tonight if you haven't already. Pre-book Lightning Lane selections and review park hours. Get to bed early — big days ahead! Keep luggage light for easy shuttle transport.

day_by_day.morning: Head to Magic Kingdom — arrive at rope drop (park opening, typically 9:00 AM) to beat the crowds. Start with Tomorrowland: Space Mountain and Buzz Lightyear's Space Ranger Spin. Move to Fantasyland for Seven Dwarfs Mine Train and Peter Pan's Flight early before lines build. Grab a Mickey-shaped pretzel (~$6) as a mid-morning snack from a cart.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Adventureland — Pirates of the Caribbean and Jungle Cruise. Grab a budget lunch at Cosmic Ray's Starlight Café (burgers, chicken, wraps ~$12–15 per person, one of the best value quick-service spots in Magic Kingdom). After lunch, take a midday break at the resort (use the free Disney bus) to avoid peak heat and crowds from 1–3 PM, then return for Frontierland — Big Thunder Mountain Railroad and Splash Mountain.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Magic Kingdom for the evening. Catch the Main Street Electrical Parade or Disney Enchantment fireworks (check schedule on app). Grab a Dole Whip (~$6) on the way out — a Disney classic and great value treat. Take the Disney bus back to the resort.

meals.breakfast: Grab a quick breakfast at the resort or bring snacks from a grocery run — budget $5–8. Alternatively, a muffin and coffee at Main Street Bakery (~$8).
meals.lunch: Cosmic Ray's Starlight Café, Magic Kingdom — ~$12–15 per person
meals.dinner: Columbia Harbour House in Liberty Square — clam chowder, lobster rolls, or fish & chips at ~$13–16 per person, a hidden gem for quality and value

day_by_day.notes: Wear comfortable walking shoes and bring sunscreen and a refillable water bottle (free water is available at any quick-service location). Use the My Disney Experience app to check live wait times. Disney buses from Aegean Bliss Resort are free.

day_by_day.morning: Head to EPCOT for rope drop. Start in World Discovery — Test Track and Mission: SPACE. Move to World Nature for Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (book Individual Lightning Lane early via app — ~$15–20 per person, worth it). Explore the beautiful EPCOT gardens and World Celebration area.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon exploring World Showcase — visit Mexico, Norway (Frozen Ever After ride), China, Japan, and Italy pavilions. Each pavilion offers free entertainment, cultural exhibits, and beautiful architecture. Grab a budget lunch at the Mexico pavilion's La Cantina de San Angel (outdoor counter service, tacos and nachos ~$12–14). Browse international merchandise — window shopping is free!
day_by_day.evening: Stay for EPCOT's spectacular nighttime show — EPCOT Forever or Luminous the Symphony of Us (check current schedule). Watch from the World Showcase Lagoon for the best views. Grab a budget-friendly crepe from the France kiosk (~$7) as a dessert treat. Take the Disney bus back to the resort.

meals.breakfast: Sunshine Seasons in The Land pavilion — excellent quick-service with healthy options, sandwiches, and hot meals at ~$10–13
meals.lunch: La Cantina de San Angel, Mexico Pavilion — tacos, nachos, churros ~$12–14
meals.dinner: Regal Eagle Smokehouse in American Adventure — BBQ platters and sandwiches ~$13–16, great portions and quality

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT is massive — wear comfortable shoes. The World Showcase opens at 11 AM (later than the rest of EPCOT). International Food & Wine Festival may be running in June — many booths offer small plates for $5–9, great for sampling global cuisine on a budget!

day_by_day.morning: Take a well-deserved rest morning — sleep in and enjoy the Aegean Bliss Resort amenities. Explore the resort pool, beachfront area, and grounds. This is a great time to visit a nearby Walmart or Publix (use Uber ~$10 each way) to stock up on snacks, breakfast items, and drinks to bring into the parks — a huge money saver for the rest of the trip.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to Disney Springs (free admission, no park ticket needed) via the free Disney bus. Explore the shops, entertainment, and street performers. Visit the LEGO Store, World of Disney (largest Disney merchandise store), and browse the unique boutiques. Catch a free outdoor performance if scheduled.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy dinner at Disney Springs — one of the best budget options on Disney property. Visit Blaze Pizza (build-your-own pizza ~$10–12), The Daily Peel (smoothies and bowls), or grab food from the outdoor marketplace kiosks. End the evening with a stroll along the waterfront and enjoy the free entertainment atmosphere.

meals.breakfast: In-room breakfast with groceries purchased earlier — cereal, fruit, yogurt ~$3–5 per person
meals.lunch: Late lunch at the resort pool bar or bring packed snacks from grocery haul — ~$5–8
meals.dinner: Blaze Pizza at Disney Springs — build-your-own pizza with unlimited toppings ~$10–12, or Chicken Guy! by Guy Fieri ~$12–14

day_by_day.notes: This rest day is essential for a 7-day trip — it prevents burnout and saves money. Disney Springs parking is free if you drive, and the Disney bus from the resort is also free. Stock up on water bottles, granola bars, and easy snacks at the grocery store — this can save $20–30/day in parks.

day_by_day.morning: Full day at Hollywood Studios — arrive at rope drop. Head immediately to Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge. Ride Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run (standby line) and Rise of the Resistance (book Individual Lightning Lane early, ~$20–25 — the most popular ride at Disney World). Explore the immersive Star Wars land and browse the Marketplace.
day_by_day.afternoon: Move to Toy Story Land — Slinky Dog Dash and Alien Swirling Saucers. Grab lunch at Woody's Lunch Box (counter service in Toy Story Land — grilled cheese, BBQ brisket melts ~$11–14, one of the most beloved quick-service spots). After lunch, head to Sunset Boulevard — Tower of Terror and Rock 'n' Roller Coaster. Visit the Animation Courtyard for Star Wars Launch Bay.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for Fantasmic! — the iconic nighttime water and fire spectacular (check showtimes, usually 8:30 or 9:00 PM). Arrive 45–60 minutes early for a good seat. This is a free included experience and absolutely not to be missed. Grab a Mickey bar (~$6) from a cart to enjoy during the show. Take the Disney bus back to the resort.

meals.breakfast: In-room breakfast from grocery supplies — toast, fruit, granola bars ~$3–5
meals.lunch: Woody's Lunch Box, Toy Story Land — grilled cheese, lunch box tarts, Powerade slushies ~$11–14
meals.dinner: Backlot Express near Star Wars Launch Bay — burgers, chicken sandwiches, wraps ~$12–15, great value and usually shorter waits

day_by_day.notes: Hollywood Studios tends to have the highest demand for Lightning Lane. Book Rise of the Resistance Individual Lightning Lane the moment the park opens via the app. Bring a portable phone charger — heavy app use drains batteries quickly.

day_by_day.morning: Full day at Animal Kingdom — arrive at rope drop. Head straight to Pandora – The World of Avatar: ride Flight of Passage first (the most popular ride in the park — waits can reach 120+ minutes by 10 AM). Then ride Na'vi River Journey. Take time to admire the stunning bioluminescent landscape of Pandora.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Africa — take the Kilimanjaro Safaris (go in the morning or late afternoon for best animal activity). Visit the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail for free wildlife viewing. Head to Asia — Expedition Everest and Kali River Rapids (you WILL get wet — great for hot June days!). Visit DinoLand U.S.A. for DINOSAUR ride and Primeval Whirl.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for Rivers of Light or the Tree of Life Awakenings (check current evening programming — projections on the Tree of Life are free and magical). Grab a budget dinner before heading out. Take the Disney bus back to the resort and do some light packing for the remaining day.

meals.breakfast: Grab a quick snack from resort supplies before heading out, or a pastry from a park cart upon arrival ~$5–7
meals.lunch: Satu'li Canteen in Pandora — one of the BEST quick-service restaurants at Disney World. Rice bowls, protein options, and unique beverages ~$13–16. Highly recommended.
meals.dinner: Flame Tree Barbecue in Discovery Island — BBQ ribs, chicken, pulled pork with beautiful outdoor waterfront seating ~$13–16. Another hidden gem for value and taste.

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom typically closes earlier than other parks (around 8–9 PM). Plan your day around early morning for best wildlife viewing on the safari. June is hot — Kali River Rapids is a welcome relief, but bring a change of clothes or a small dry bag for valuables.

day_by_day.morning: Return to your favorite park for a final morning — Magic Kingdom is ideal for a nostalgic farewell. Arrive at rope drop and hit any rides you missed or want to ride again. Pick up any last-minute souvenirs — the best budget souvenirs are magnet sets, keychains, and pressed pennies (just 51 cents!). Visit the Main Street Confectionery for a sweet treat.
day_by_day.afternoon: Check out of Aegean Bliss Resort (standard checkout ~11 AM — ask about late checkout if your flight allows). Store luggage at the bell desk. Head to Disney Springs for a final afternoon of free browsing and entertainment. Visit the Marketplace Co-Op for unique Disney merchandise, or grab a final treat from Amorette's Patisserie (beautiful and relatively affordable pastries ~$6–9).
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a final budget-friendly dinner at Disney Springs before heading to the airport. Allow extra time for transportation — take a rideshare (Uber/Lyft ~$25–35) to Orlando International Airport. Arrive at least 2.5 hours before your departure for security and boarding.

meals.breakfast: Final in-room breakfast with remaining grocery supplies, or grab a quick bite at the resort food court ~$8–10
meals.lunch: Earl of Sandwich at Disney Springs — one of the best value meals on Disney property. Hot sandwiches, wraps, salads ~$9–11. A Disney Springs institution.
meals.dinner: Splitsville Luxury Lanes at Disney Springs — surprisingly affordable lunch/dinner menu with flatbreads, burgers, and sushi ~$13–17, or grab a quick meal at The Daily Peel or a food kiosk ~$8–12 before heading to the airport

day_by_day.notes: Don't forget to check for any remaining MagicBand credits or gift card balances. Return any rented items. Take one last photo in front of your favorite Disney landmark! Total estimated daily food budget per person: $35–55/day eating primarily at quick-service locations and using grocery-purchased snacks and breakfasts. Total 7-day food estimate per person: ~$250–385.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — late night arrival
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities scheduled — late night arrival
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Orlando International Airport via Flight UA at 22:30. Take Disney's Magical Express or a rideshare to Aegean Bliss Resort. Check in, unpack, and get settled into your Beachfront room. Take a short stroll along the resort grounds to get oriented.

meals.breakfast: Eat before or during your flight
meals.lunch: Eat before or during your flight
meals.dinner: Grab a late-night bite at the resort's lobby bar or a quick-service option on property if available, or pick up snacks from a resort convenience shop

day_by_day.notes: Arrival is at 22:30, so keep Day 1 light. Confirm your park tickets and reservations are loaded onto the My Disney Experience app. Set an early alarm for Day 2 to maximize your first full park day. Hydrate well after travel.

day_by_day.morning: Magic Kingdom Park Full Day — Arrive at park rope drop (typically 8:00–9:00 AM). Head straight to Tomorrowland to ride Space Mountain before lines build. Follow with The Haunted Mansion and Pirates of the Caribbean. Use Lightning Lane passes strategically for top-tier attractions.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue Magic Kingdom exploration — After lunch, experience Fantasyland classics including Seven Dwarfs Mine Train, Peter Pan's Flight, and 'it's a small world'. Catch the Festival of Fantasy Parade (usually around 3:00 PM) along Main Street U.S.A. for a spectacular mid-afternoon show.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for Magic Kingdom's iconic nighttime spectacular — EPCOT Forever or Magic Kingdom's Enchantment fireworks display (check schedule on app). Enjoy the Main Street Electrical Parade if running. Exit after fireworks to beat the crowd.

meals.breakfast: Quick breakfast at the resort before heading out, or grab a Mickey waffle at Main Street Bakery inside Magic Kingdom
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House in Liberty Square — mid-range counter service with clam chowder, lobster rolls, and fried fish platters (~$15–$20 per person)
meals.dinner: Be Our Guest Restaurant in Fantasyland (book in advance) for a mid-range sit-down experience inside the Beast's Castle, or Tony's Town Square Restaurant on Main Street (~$25–$40 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Purchase Lightning Lane Multi Pass in advance for Magic Kingdom. Wear comfortable shoes — expect 10–15k steps. Stay hydrated in the Florida June heat. Arrive 30 minutes before park open for best ride access.

day_by_day.morning: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour — Arrive at EPCOT for rope drop and head to Future World (now World Discovery & World Nature) first. Ride Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind and Test Track early before lines grow. Then transition to World Showcase as it opens around 11:00 AM.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore EPCOT's World Showcase pavilions — Begin at Mexico (ride Gran Fiesta Tour), stroll through Norway (Frozen Ever After ride), Germany, Italy, and Japan. Sample small bites and beverages from each country pavilion as part of the food and culture experience. Don't miss the artisan demos and cultural performances.
day_by_day.evening: Wrap up the World Showcase loop through Morocco, France, United Kingdom, and Canada. Stay for EPCOT's nighttime show 'Luminous: The Symphony of Us' over World Showcase Lagoon — a stunning fireworks and projection spectacular. Depart after the show.

meals.breakfast: Grab a croissant and coffee at the France Pavilion's Les Halles Boulangerie-Patisserie when it opens, or eat at the resort before arrival
meals.lunch: Graze World Showcase food booths — try a school bread from Norway, tacos from Mexico, and a crepe from France (~$8–$15 per item, budget $30–$40 total for grazing)
meals.dinner: Teppan Edo in the Japan Pavilion — hibachi-style dinner, mid-range at ~$35–$50 per person. Book in advance via My Disney Experience app.

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT's World Showcase is perfect for foodies and culture lovers. Wear light, breathable clothing. The June heat peaks in the afternoon — use the indoor pavilions as a break. Check the app for live entertainment schedules at each pavilion.

day_by_day.morning: Hollywood Studios Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Adventure — Arrive at park open and head directly to Galaxy's Edge. Join the virtual queue or purchase Individual Lightning Lane for Rise of the Resistance (book at 7:00 AM on the app). While waiting, explore the immersive land — visit the Millennium Falcon and interact with Cast Member characters.
day_by_day.afternoon: Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run ride, then visit Savi's Workshop to build a custom lightsaber (~$249.99 — optional splurge). Explore the Docking Bay 7 area, then transition to the rest of Hollywood Studios — ride Slinky Dog Dash in Toy Story Land and Mickey & Minnie's Runaway Railway.
day_by_day.evening: Catch the Star Wars: A Galactic Spectacular fireworks and projection show on the Chinese Theatre (one of Disney's best nighttime shows). Before the show, grab a spot near Echo Lake. End the night with a stroll through Sunset Boulevard to see the Tower of Terror lit up at night.

meals.breakfast: Eat at the resort before heading to the park — grab something quick to maximize early morning ride access
meals.lunch: Docking Bay 7 Food and Cargo inside Galaxy's Edge — mid-range quick service with creative Star Wars-themed dishes like Smoked Kaadu Ribs and Fried Endorian Tip-Yip (~$15–$22 per person)
meals.dinner: Sci-Fi Dine-In Theater Restaurant — unique drive-in movie atmosphere with burgers, sandwiches, and milkshakes (~$25–$40 per person). Book in advance.

day_by_day.notes: Rise of the Resistance Individual Lightning Lane sells out quickly — purchase at exactly 7:00 AM. Galaxy's Edge is extremely immersive; allow at least 3–4 hours. June crowds can be high; use the My Disney Experience app to monitor wait times throughout the day.

day_by_day.morning: Animal Kingdom Safari & Avatar Flight of Passage — Arrive at park open (typically 8:00 AM). Head immediately to Pandora – The World of Avatar. Ride Avatar: Flight of Passage first thing — this is the most in-demand ride at Walt Disney World. Follow with Na'vi River Journey for a gentler experience through the bioluminescent forest.
day_by_day.afternoon: Embark on the Kilimanjaro Safaris (best in the morning or late afternoon for active animals, but afternoon still rewarding). See lions, elephants, giraffes, zebras, and more on the open-air safari vehicle. Explore the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail on foot. Visit Expedition Everest in Asia for a thrilling roller coaster experience.
day_by_day.evening: Experience Rivers of Light nighttime show or Tree of Life Awakenings (check current schedule as shows rotate). Enjoy the magical illumination of the Tree of Life with animal spirits projected across it. Depart after the evening show, arriving back at the resort for a relaxing night.

meals.breakfast: Grab a quick bite at the resort or Creature Comforts (Starbucks licensed) at Animal Kingdom's entry plaza
meals.lunch: Satu'li Canteen in Pandora — one of Disney's best quick-service restaurants. Try the Cheeseburger Pods or Grain Bowls (~$15–$20 per person)
meals.dinner: Yak & Yeti Restaurant in Asia — Asian-fusion sit-down dining with dishes like Honey Chicken and Ahi Tuna Nachos (~$25–$40 per person). Book in advance.

day_by_day.notes: Avatar: Flight of Passage is a must-do — purchase Lightning Lane Individual if needed. Animal sightings on the safari are best in cooler morning or late afternoon hours. Bring sunscreen and a light rain poncho as afternoon thunderstorms are common in June in Orlando.

day_by_day.morning: Resort Relaxation Morning — Take a well-deserved rest morning at Aegean Bliss Resort. Enjoy the beachfront amenities — lounge by the pool, take a morning walk along the waterfront, or enjoy a leisurely resort breakfast. This is a great recovery day after four consecutive park days.
day_by_day.afternoon: Disney Springs Family Entertainment Day — Head to Disney Springs in the early afternoon (free admission, no park ticket required). Explore unique shops like World of Disney (largest Disney merchandise store), LEGO Store, and Splitsville Luxury Lanes. Let kids experience the interactive LEGO fountain and outdoor entertainment stages.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy Disney Springs' evening atmosphere with street performers, live music, and ambient lighting over the water. Browse the entertainment district and enjoy a relaxed, no-rush evening before the final park day tomorrow.

meals.breakfast: Full resort breakfast at Aegean Bliss Resort's restaurant — enjoy a relaxed sit-down meal (~$15–$25 per person)
meals.lunch: D-Luxe Burger at Disney Springs — gourmet burgers with creative toppings in a mid-range quick-service setting (~$15–$20 per person)
meals.dinner: The BOATHOUSE at Disney Springs — waterfront dining with seafood, steaks, and Amphicar boat rides. Mid-range to slightly upscale at ~$35–$55 per person. A memorable final dinner experience. Book in advance.

day_by_day.notes: Disney Springs is free to enter and a great low-key day. Parking is free in the Disney Springs garages. The BOATHOUSE is popular — reservations strongly recommended. This day allows tired feet to recover before the final park day. Splitsville bowling is available for family fun ($20–$30 per person per game).

day_by_day.morning: Return to a favorite park or revisit highlights — Based on the family's favorite experiences from the week, choose one park for a final half-day visit. Recommended: Return to Magic Kingdom for any missed attractions or to re-ride favorites. Alternatively, revisit EPCOT for any pavilions you didn't fully explore. Arrive at rope drop for maximum time.
day_by_day.afternoon: Final souvenir shopping and park farewell — Spend the early afternoon picking up last-minute souvenirs at the park's main gift shops or at Disney Springs if preferred. Head back to Aegean Bliss Resort by mid-afternoon to begin packing and preparing for departure.
day_by_day.evening: Resort farewell evening — Enjoy one final sunset from the beachfront at Aegean Bliss Resort. Have a relaxed dinner on property or nearby. Confirm transportation arrangements for departure. Review any remaining My Disney Experience PhotoPass photos and purchase if desired (Disney PhotoPass packages available).

meals.breakfast: Quick breakfast at the resort or grab a Mickey pretzel and coffee at the park upon arrival
meals.lunch: Enjoy a final park lunch at a favorite quick-service spot — Casey's Corner hot dogs at Magic Kingdom (~$12–$18) or a World Showcase snack at EPCOT
meals.dinner: Casual resort dinner at Aegean Bliss Resort's on-site dining — a relaxed farewell meal to close out the trip (~$20–$35 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Check park hours carefully as Sunday hours may vary. Download and purchase any Disney PhotoPass photos before leaving — they expire after 45 days. Confirm your return flight details and arrange transportation to Orlando International Airport in advance. Pack the night before to allow a stress-free departure morning.

Check in to your Beachfront suite, enjoy a welcome amenity and light room-service refreshments. Unwind and prepare for the week ahead.

meals.breakfast: Onboard or at the airport before departure
meals.lunch: Onboard or at the airport
meals.dinner: In-room private dining at Aegean Bliss Resort — order from the premium late-night room service menu featuring artisan charcuterie boards, gourmet sandwiches, and a curated wine or mocktail selection

day_by_day.notes: Pre-arrange express check-in with the resort concierge before travel day to minimize wait time upon late arrival. Ensure Disney park tickets and Lightning Lane Multi Pass are already linked to your My Disney Experience app. Lay out park essentials for Day 2 before sleeping.

day_by_day.morning: Magic Kingdom Park Full Day — Arrive at rope drop (park opens ~9:00 AM) to maximize the experience before crowds build. Begin with Tomorrowland: ride Space Mountain and TRON Lightcycle Run using early Lightning Lane reservations. Move to Fantasyland for Seven Dwarfs Mine Train and Peter Pan's Flight. Enjoy the relatively light early-morning crowds with a leisurely walk down Main Street, U.S.A., stopping for photos in front of Cinderella Castle.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue the Magic Kingdom adventure through Adventureland — Pirates of the Caribbean and Jungle Cruise. Head to Liberty Square for Haunted Mansion. Use Lightning Lane passes strategically for any remaining top-tier attractions. Take a mid-afternoon resort break back at Aegean Bliss for pool time and relaxation during peak heat hours (2:00–4:00 PM), then return to the park refreshed for the evening.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Magic Kingdom for the spectacular nighttime offerings: TRON or Big Thunder Mountain with shorter evening queues, followed by prime positioning for the Happily Ever After fireworks spectacular over Cinderella Castle. Secure a reserved dining table at Be Our Guest Restaurant for an immersive Beauty and the Beast dinner experience inside the Beast's enchanted castle.

meals.breakfast: Elegant resort breakfast at Aegean Bliss Resort's signature restaurant — eggs Benedict, fresh tropical fruits, pastries, and specialty coffee before rope drop
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House or Skipper Canteen (Jungle Navigation Co.) inside Magic Kingdom — elevated quick-service with themed ambiance and fresh seafood options
meals.dinner: Be Our Guest Restaurant, Magic Kingdom — prix-fixe dinner featuring French-inspired cuisine including braised pork, salmon, and crème brûlée in the stunning ballroom setting (advance reservation essential)

day_by_day.notes: Purchase Individual Lightning Lane selections for TRON Lightcycle Run and Seven Dwarfs Mine Train the moment the park opens. Wear comfortable, breathable attire — June in Orlando is hot and humid (expect 90°F+). Bring personal fans, sunscreen, and a portable phone charger. The resort concierge can arrange a dedicated Disney transportation plan for the day.

day_by_day.morning: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour — Arrive at EPCOT for a late morning start (10:00 AM) after a leisurely resort breakfast. Begin in Future World with Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (secure Lightning Lane early) and Test Track. Transition to the World Showcase as it opens at 11:00 AM. Start your cultural journey in Canada and work clockwise through the United Kingdom, France, Morocco, Japan, and the American Adventure pavilion. Engage with live cultural performers and artisans at each pavilion.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue the World Showcase food and culture tour through Italy, Germany, China, Norway (Frozen Ever After ride — use Lightning Lane), and Mexico (Gran Fiesta Tour boat ride). Sample signature dishes and beverages at each country pavilion — Norwegian School Bread, Japanese sushi, French macarons, Mexican street corn, and Moroccan lamb flatbread. Participate in the EPCOT International Food & Wine Festival activities if running during this period (typically June–November).
day_by_day.evening: Conclude the day with the breathtaking EPCOT Forever or Luminous: The Symphony of Us nighttime spectacular over World Showcase Lagoon. Secure a premium waterfront viewing spot with a reserved table at La Hacienda de San Angel (Mexico) or Monsieur Paul (France) for dinner with lagoon views during the show.

meals.breakfast: Leisurely resort breakfast at Aegean Bliss — avocado toast, smoked salmon bagels, fresh-pressed juices, and specialty lattes on the beachfront terrace
meals.lunch: Progressive World Showcase tasting lunch — curated small plates across 4–5 country pavilions including sushi at Takumi-Tei (Japan), crêpes at Les Halles Boulangerie (France), and School Bread at Kringla Bakeri (Norway)
meals.dinner: Monsieur Paul, EPCOT France Pavilion — an upscale French fine-dining experience with a prix-fixe menu featuring duck confit, bouillabaisse, and classic French desserts with panoramic lagoon views (advance reservation required)

day_by_day.notes: Monsieur Paul is one of Walt Disney World's most acclaimed fine-dining restaurants — book 60 days in advance. Wear comfortable walking shoes as EPCOT's World Showcase is approximately 1.3 miles around the lagoon. The evening show viewing is best from the Italy or Japan waterfront areas if dining reservations are not available.

day_by_day.morning: Hollywood Studios Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Adventure — Arrive at rope drop for this immersive experience. Head directly to Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance (one of Disney's most technically impressive attractions) using Individual Lightning Lane. Then experience Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run. Explore the Black Spire Outpost marketplace, interact with stormtroopers and Dok-Ondar's Den of Antiquities, and book a Savi's Workshop Handbuilt Lightsaber experience (private reservation, ~$300 per lightsaber) — a premium, once-in-a-lifetime family memory.
day_by_day.afternoon: After Galaxy's Edge, explore the rest of Hollywood Studios: Tower of Terror (Hollywood Tower Hotel), Slinky Dog Dash in Toy Story Land, and Alien Swirling Saucers. Visit MuppetVision 3D for a classic family laugh. Take a mid-afternoon break at the resort pool to escape peak heat, then return for the evening entertainment lineup.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Hollywood Studios for the spectacular Fantasmic! nighttime show — arrive 45 minutes early for premium seating (Fantasmic! Dining Package available for reserved seats). End the evening at Oga's Cantina in Galaxy's Edge for exotic themed cocktails and mocktails in the Star Wars universe, a premium reservation-only experience.

meals.breakfast: Character breakfast at Aegean Bliss Resort or a quick resort café grab-and-go to ensure rope-drop arrival at Hollywood Studios
meals.lunch: Docking Bay 7 Food and Cargo, Galaxy's Edge — themed quick-service with Felucian Garden Spread, Smoked Kaadu Ribs, and Batuu-inspired beverages in a fully immersive Star Wars environment
meals.dinner: Fantasmic! Dining Package at Hollywood & Vine or Mama Melrose's Ristorante Italiano — prix-fixe dinner includes guaranteed Fantasmic! reserved seating. Alternatively, The Hollywood Brown Derby for upscale American cuisine including the famous Cobb Salad

day_by_day.notes: Savi's Workshop lightsaber building requires advance reservations and fills up months ahead — book through Disney's website as early as possible (60-day booking window for resort guests). Oga's Cantina also requires reservations. June heat peaks between 1–4 PM; the afternoon resort break is highly recommended for families with children.

day_by_day.morning: Animal Kingdom Safari & Avatar Flight of Passage — Arrive at rope drop to experience Kilimanjaro Safaris at its best: animals are most active in the cooler morning hours. Witness lions, elephants, giraffes, zebras, rhinos, and hippos in expansive, naturalistic habitats. Follow with Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail and Maharajah Jungle Trek for up-close wildlife encounters. Head to Pandora — The World of Avatar and secure a Lightning Lane for Avatar: Flight of Passage, widely regarded as one of the greatest theme park attractions ever created.
day_by_day.afternoon: Experience Na'vi River Journey in Pandora for a serene, visually stunning boat ride. Explore the bioluminescent beauty of the Pandora landscape. Visit Discovery Island for It's Tough to Be a Bug! and the Tree of Life garden walk. Enjoy the Festival of the Lion King live theatrical show — a premium, high-energy Broadway-caliber performance. Take a resort break during peak afternoon heat.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Animal Kingdom for the Rivers of Light nighttime spectacular (if operating) or explore Pandora as it transforms into a glowing bioluminescent landscape after dark — one of Disney's most magical visual experiences. Dine at Tiffins Restaurant for a refined, globally-inspired culinary journey.

meals.breakfast: Full resort breakfast at Aegean Bliss — eggs your way, tropical fruit platters, fresh-baked pastries, and cold brew coffee to energize for the safari morning
meals.lunch: Satu'li Canteen, Pandora — Avatar-themed quick-service featuring healthy, globally inspired bowls with customizable proteins, grains, and sauces in a stunning alien landscape setting
meals.dinner: Tiffins Restaurant, Animal Kingdom — Disney's most artistically curated fine-dining experience with globally inspired dishes such as sustainable fish, short rib, and Thip Khao-style duck. Features stunning artwork and intimate ambiance (advance reservation essential)

day_by_day.notes: Avatar: Flight of Passage is a must-do and has some of the longest waits in all of Walt Disney World — Lightning Lane Individual purchase is strongly recommended. Tiffins is consistently rated among the top Disney dining experiences; reserve 60 days in advance. The Pandora bioluminescent landscape at dusk is a truly magical, photo-worthy experience — plan to stay until after sunset.

day_by_day.morning: Relaxed luxury resort morning at Aegean Bliss — sleep in, enjoy a premium spa treatment (book resort spa services: deep tissue massage, facial, or couples treatment), and lounge on the beachfront. Take a leisurely swim in the resort pool. This is a planned recovery day from the high-energy park days — essential for maintaining energy and enjoyment throughout the trip.
day_by_day.afternoon: Disney Springs Family Entertainment Day — Arrive at Disney Springs (1:00 PM) for a leisurely afternoon of world-class shopping, entertainment, and dining. Explore The LEGO Store, World of Disney, Arribas Brothers (custom crystal and glasswork), and upscale boutiques. Visit the NBA Experience for interactive basketball activities. Catch a show at the House of Blues or Cirque du Soleil's Drawn to Life (advance tickets recommended) — an extraordinary acrobatic performance blending Disney animation with world-class circus arts.
day_by_day.evening: Spend the evening at Disney Springs exploring its vibrant waterfront dining scene. Enjoy live music performances at multiple outdoor stages throughout the complex. Browse the artisan market stalls and boutique shops. End the evening with a premium dessert experience or nightcap at a rooftop bar before returning to the resort.

meals.breakfast: Indulgent resort brunch at Aegean Bliss — eggs Benedict royale with smoked salmon, Belgian waffles with fresh berries, mimosa or fresh-pressed juice flight on the beachfront terrace
meals.lunch: STK Orlando, Disney Springs — upscale modern steakhouse with premium lunch menu featuring wagyu burgers, fresh seafood, and craft cocktails in a chic, energetic atmosphere
meals.dinner: Morimoto Asia, Disney Springs — Iron Chef Masaharu Morimoto's flagship pan-Asian restaurant featuring Peking duck, dim sum, sashimi platters, and signature wagyu dishes in a stunning two-story waterfront setting (advance reservation strongly recommended)

day_by_day.notes: Cirque du Soleil's Drawn to Life tickets should be purchased well in advance — premium seating options available. The spa at Aegean Bliss should be booked before the trip begins to secure preferred morning appointment times. Disney Springs is free to enter with no park ticket required, making it an ideal low-key day. June Saturdays can be busy at Disney Springs — arrive by 1:00 PM to secure parking or use resort transportation.

day_by_day.morning: Final Disney morning — return to Magic Kingdom for any missed attractions or favorite re-rides. Enjoy the park with a relaxed, unhurried pace now that Lightning Lane strategies are well-practiced. Revisit Cinderella Castle for final family photos. Take a leisurely stroll down Main Street, U.S.A. for last-minute souvenir shopping at the Emporium and specialty stores. Purchase premium Disney keepsakes, custom ears, and personalized gifts.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to Aegean Bliss Resort by early afternoon for final pool time and relaxation. Begin packing and organizing luggage. Utilize the resort's Disney Luggage Transfer Service if flying home — check bags directly from the resort (available for select airlines). Enjoy a final resort amenity experience: beachfront cabana, signature cocktails, and a sunset view.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell luxury dinner at the resort's signature fine-dining restaurant. Reflect on the week's magical memories over a premium multi-course meal. Arrange private car transfer to Orlando International Airport for departure flight. Ensure all Disney merchandise, park maps, and keepsakes are carefully packed. Check out of Aegean Bliss Resort with express checkout service.

meals.breakfast: Final resort breakfast — full American spread with custom omelets, French toast, fresh tropical fruits, and specialty coffee. Savor the beachfront view one last time
meals.lunch: Crystal Palace, Magic Kingdom — elegant buffet dining with Winnie the Pooh character meet-and-greet in a stunning Victorian greenhouse setting; a perfect final park dining memory for families
meals.dinner: Aegean Bliss Resort Signature Restaurant — premium farewell dinner featuring resort-exclusive dishes such as butter-poached lobster, prime dry-aged ribeye, artisan cheese boards, and a curated wine pairing or mocktail flight to celebrate a perfect Disney World vacation

day_by_day.notes: Disney's Magical Express luggage service or a private luxury car transfer should be pre-booked for airport departure. If the return flight is early the next morning, consider requesting a late checkout from Aegean Bliss Resort to enjoy the full final evening. Purchase any last Disney PhotoPass downloads before leaving — My Disney Experience photos expire after 45 days. Keep one small bag accessible for airport essentials during the final resort afternoon.

query: Disney World Orlando family of 4, $6000, 7 days, June 2026
